question_text: In a laboratory-based investigation of the photosynthesis rate (y) of the plant Larrea tridenta and its relation to the level of radiance (x), 11 paired observations were taken. The data were summarized by: sum(X) = 56.2, sum(X^2) = 335.18, sum(Y^2) = 41244, sum(XY) = 3688.3. Calculate the equation of the estimated regression line of y on x.
explanation: b = (n*sum(XY) - sum(X)*sum(Y)) / (n*sum(X^2) - (sum(X))^2). With the implied sum(Y), b ~ 11.47 and a ~ -2.78.

question_text: In a laboratory-based investigation of the photosynthesis rate (y) of the plant Larrea tridenta, the estimated regression equation of photosynthesis rate on irradiance is y = -2.78 + 11.47x. Estimate the photosynthesis rate when the level of irradiance is 5.2.
In a test of linear relationship between 2 variables x and y, if the sum of squares due to regression is 20, the total sum of squares is 25, and n = 10, what is the F-Ratio?
explanation: SSE = SST - SSR = 25 - 20 = 5. Residual df = n - 2 = 8. F = (SSR/1)/(SSE/8) = 20/(5/8) = 32.
